cohort: 104 preterm infants with gestational age less than 34 weeks who were treated in the NICU.
finding: Severe respiratory disorders in preterm infants were associated with decreased dopamine levels, while serotonin and β-endorphin levels were correlated in this case; neonatal seizures were associated with decreased β-endorphin levels, but increased correlation between β-endorphin and serotonin; dopamine was lower and β-endorphin higher in twins than singletons; serotonin was higher in infants born by cesarean.
mod_finding: Serotonin level was significantly higher in neonates born by caesarean section.
